rationale: Marceli brings product design expertise from Huge Design focused on user-centered digital experiences, while Hana is building full-stack and systems projects as a software engineer intern at Figma—a natural pairing since Figma sits at the intersection of design tooling and engineering. They can explore how design and frontend/systems thinking complement each other, with Hana's multi-language stack (Python, C++, Java, CSS) and Marceli's product design perspective offering mutual learning opportunities.
intro_message: Marceli Rogała, meet Hana Hassan — Marceli designs digital experiences at Huge Design and Hana builds full-stack projects at Figma, so you two can swap perspectives on the design-engineering workflow.
